mcpDocs.pageSubtitle: Connect AI coding agents — Claude Code, Cursor, Cline — and build bots directly from your terminal or IDE.
mcpDocs.whatBody: MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open standard that lets AI agents call tools on external services. The Botspace MCP server exposes the full platform — project management, flow builder (80+ tools), CMS collections, debug/deploy, and CRM broadcasts — so any MCP client can drive your bots programmatically.
